sources.name: NWS forecasts, observations and alerts
sources.update_frequency: Event driven; observations can lag. Respect cache headers and rate limits.
sources.license_notes: Documentation permits free use for any purpose; identify the application with a User-Agent.
sources.security_use: Weather alerts around facilities, outdoor operations and travel corridors.
sources.limitations: Some alerts use forecast zones without direct polygon geometry; an alert does not confirm damage.

sources.name: National Hurricane Center GIS products
sources.coverage: Atlantic and eastern North Pacific; product coverage varies
sources.update_frequency: Advisory and product schedules; archives are also available.
sources.license_notes: Public NOAA products; retain attribution and product-specific caveats.
sources.security_use: Hurricane planning, coastal facilities and port disruption awareness.
sources.limitations: The forecast cone describes track uncertainty, not the full area of hazards.

sources.name: National Water Prediction Service
sources.coverage: United States; coverage varies by gauge and model product
sources.update_frequency: Observation, forecast and model schedules vary.
sources.license_notes: Public NOAA service; check each GIS product's terms and operational status.
sources.security_use: River flooding awareness near sites, access roads and supply routes.
sources.limitations: Flood forecasts and river gauges do not report drinking-water service outages.

sources.name: AirNow air quality observations and forecasts
sources.coverage: Supported reporting areas, principally United States
sources.update_frequency: Observation and forecast schedules vary; see endpoint documentation.
sources.license_notes: API key required; follow AirNow Data Use Guidelines and request limits.
sources.security_use: Smoke and air-quality awareness for outdoor staff and facility operations.
sources.limitations: Preliminary regional observations are not a measurement of indoor conditions.

sources.name: USGS earthquake feeds
sources.update_frequency: Summary feeds refresh every minute; events can be revised.
sources.license_notes: Public USGS data; retain source attribution and revision timestamps.
sources.security_use: Seismic awareness and initial screening of potentially exposed facilities.
sources.limitations: Magnitude and distance alone do not establish site damage; use appropriate shaking products.

sources.name: FIRMS active fire and thermal anomalies
sources.coverage: Global for MODIS/VIIRS; some products restricted to US/Canada
sources.update_frequency: Satellite overpass and processing dependent; NRT, RT and URT availability varies.
sources.license_notes: Free MAP_KEY for API use; follow NASA/FIRMS attribution and transaction limits.
sources.security_use: Wildfire awareness around sites, routes and utility corridors.
sources.limitations: Thermal detections can represent industrial heat; points are not fire perimeters or confirmed impact.

sources.name: GDACS disaster alerts and geospatial services
sources.update_frequency: Event updates and feed schedules; verify timestamps.
sources.license_notes: API quickstart describes free data access; check attribution and individual product terms.
sources.security_use: International disaster awareness and regional exposure screening.
sources.limitations: Modelled alert levels are screening signals; local impacts require confirmation.

sources.name: FBI Crime Data Explorer
sources.update_frequency: Release based; inspect reporting period and agency participation.
sources.license_notes: Public statistical releases; consult dataset documentation and methodology.
sources.security_use: Area-level security planning and understanding reported crime patterns.
sources.limitations: Not a live incident or dispatch feed. Missing submissions and changing reporting practices affect comparisons.

sources.name: Chicago reported crimes
sources.provider: Chicago Police Department / City of Chicago
sources.update_frequency: Updated daily; excludes the most recent seven days.
sources.license_notes: City terms apply; metadata prohibits deriving exact addresses from approximate locations.
sources.security_use: Local reported-incident context for site planning.
sources.limitations: Block-level locations and preliminary classifications. Provider cautions against comparisons over time; not current dispatch.

sources.name: NYPD complaint data, current year to date
sources.update_frequency: Periodic release covering completed reporting periods; check current rows and metadata.
sources.license_notes: NYC Open Data terms apply; license identifier not supplied in reviewed metadata.
sources.security_use: Reported-incident context around facilities and routes.
sources.limitations: The description contains a stale year reference; inspect record dates. Complaints are not convictions or live dispatch.

sources.name: GDELT event and news data
sources.coverage: Global news coverage; uneven by language and region
sources.update_frequency: Some GDELT 2.0 datasets update every 15 minutes; product windows vary.
sources.license_notes: Provider describes database as free and open; underlying news articles retain publisher rights.
sources.security_use: Discover reports of protests, disruption and other emerging events.
sources.limitations: Machine-extracted events and place mentions need corroboration, deduplication and geolocation review.

sources.name: ACLED political violence and protest data
sources.coverage: Global; collection and release coverage vary
sources.update_frequency: Curated releases and revisions; inspect product schedule.
sources.license_notes: Account and applicable access agreement required. Commercial reuse and redistribution depend on ACLED's current EULA and written permissions.
sources.security_use: Regional context for event exposure and travel planning.
sources.limitations: Not an emergency feed; review event and geographic precision. A peaceful protest is not evidence of a threat.

sources.name: NYC permitted event information
sources.provider: NYC Office of Citywide Event Coordination and Management
sources.update_frequency: Rolling list of approved events in the next month; inspect updates.
sources.license_notes: NYC Open Data terms apply; license identifier not supplied in reviewed metadata.
sources.security_use: Plan access, staffing and travel around permitted public events.
sources.limitations: Does not include all gatherings. Film permits included only when street impacts meet the dataset's duration criterion.

sources.name: OpenSky aircraft state vectors
sources.update_frequency: Near real time where receivers report; API quotas apply.
sources.license_notes: OAuth2 client credentials. Written license required for commercial entities and operational REST API use; see current terms.
sources.security_use: Airspace awareness and aviation exposure research where licensed.
sources.limitations: ADS-B coverage gaps and incomplete identity data; does not supply airline schedules or establish passenger identity.

sources.name: FAA National Airspace System status
sources.update_frequency: Operational status updates; inspect published times.
sources.license_notes: Public FAA status page; no reusable machine endpoint was validated for this entry.
sources.security_use: Airport and airspace disruption awareness for travel and logistics.
sources.limitations: Status page is not a complete aircraft position feed or flight-specific guarantee.

sources.name: Aviation Weather Center Data API
sources.coverage: Worldwide observations and forecasts; some products regional
sources.update_frequency: Product dependent; latest observations and recent history.
sources.license_notes: Public API with query limits; use cache downloads for bulk data and follow provider guidance.
sources.security_use: Weather disruption context at airports and along planned air travel.
sources.limitations: Aviation weather is not aircraft traffic; product coverage and observation ages differ.

sources.name: Marine Cadastre vessel traffic / AIS
sources.coverage: US coastal waters and supported vessel-traffic products
sources.update_frequency: Published archives and derived products; inspect each release.
sources.license_notes: Publicly distributed products; retain dataset metadata and check release-specific use constraints.
sources.security_use: Historical shipping patterns, port approaches and maritime exposure planning.
sources.limitations: Not a live AIS feed. AccessAIS ordering was unavailable when reviewed; its page points to bulk downloads.

sources.name: NGA maritime navigational warnings
sources.coverage: Maritime warning areas and US shipping interests; coverage varies
sources.update_frequency: Warnings issued and cancelled as conditions change.
sources.license_notes: Public maritime safety information; follow product usage notices.
sources.security_use: Maritime route awareness, navigation hazards and regional shipping disruption.
sources.limitations: Not a live vessel feed and not a replacement for required official onboard warning services.

sources.name: MarineTraffic / Kpler AIS Data API
sources.coverage: Global, subject to receiver coverage and subscription
sources.update_frequency: Service- and subscription-dependent live and historical access.
sources.license_notes: Proprietary API; API key and applicable paid agreement required. Included as a licensed option.
sources.security_use: Vessel-position and maritime logistics awareness where contracted.
sources.limitations: Public map access does not grant bulk API or redistribution rights; AIS can be delayed or incomplete.

sources.name: 511NY traffic API
sources.provider: New York State Department of Transportation
sources.coverage: New York State and included neighboring observations
sources.update_frequency: Operational updates; inspect individual event times.
sources.license_notes: Developer key and Developer Access Agreement required.
sources.security_use: Road incidents, closures, construction and travel disruption around routes.
sources.limitations: Coverage is not every street; camera availability does not confer unrestricted image reuse.

sources.name: Caltrans QuickMap
sources.update_frequency: Operational traffic, closure and incident updates.
sources.license_notes: Public traveler information; check layer terms before integration. No supported API validated here.
sources.security_use: California road closure and travel-condition awareness.
sources.limitations: Map layers have different providers and timestamps; QuickMap is not a navigation application.

sources.name: DriveTexas highway conditions
sources.update_frequency: Updates from TxDOT operations; inspect event times.
sources.license_notes: Public traveler information; no supported public integration API validated here.
sources.security_use: Texas road conditions, crashes, closures and logistics awareness.
sources.limitations: State roadway coverage does not establish the status of every local access road.

sources.name: OpenFEMA disaster declarations and program data
sources.update_frequency: Dataset-specific administrative updates.
sources.license_notes: Public OpenFEMA data; review dataset metadata and terms.
sources.security_use: Declared disasters, affected jurisdictions and recovery context.
sources.limitations: Declarations and aid records are not live evacuation or incident alerts. Documentation fetch returned 403 in this review.

sources.name: Federal Register API
sources.provider: Office of the Federal Register / Government Publishing Office
sources.update_frequency: Publication schedule; inspect dates and document status.
sources.license_notes: Public API without keys; linked source documents may have additional notices.
sources.security_use: Track agency notices, emergency declarations and infrastructure-related policy changes.
sources.limitations: Text usually needs geographic interpretation; verify legal reliance against the linked official edition.

sources.name: Data.gov catalog
sources.provider: US General Services Administration and contributing agencies
sources.coverage: United States federal, state and local contributors
sources.update_frequency: Catalog and underlying datasets update separately.
sources.license_notes: Licenses and access conditions are dataset-specific; catalog inclusion is not blanket permission.
sources.security_use: Discover local government, infrastructure and emergency-management sources.
sources.limitations: A catalog record is not an operational feed; validate the underlying publisher and resource.

sources.name: ReliefWeb reports and disasters API
sources.update_frequency: Continuously curated reports; publication lag varies.
sources.license_notes: No API fee; pre-approved appname required since November 2025. Original publishers retain content rights.
sources.security_use: Humanitarian situation reports and international operational context.
sources.limitations: Reports can reference broad areas and older events; distinguish reporting time from event time.

sources.name: PowerOutage.us
sources.coverage: Tracked utilities in the United States; other markets via provider products
sources.update_frequency: Provider and utility dependent; inspect freshness.
sources.license_notes: Public viewing and licensed API products are distinct. API use and redistribution are governed by commercial terms.
sources.security_use: Area-level electricity disruption and business-continuity awareness.
sources.limitations: Outage counts and estimated affected areas do not prove a particular building has lost power.

sources.name: EAGLE-I historical power outage data, 2014-2022
sources.coverage: United States, reporting utility coverage varies
sources.update_frequency: Fixed historical release; this entry is specifically the 2014-2022 dataset.
sources.license_notes: Review repository license and citation instructions before reuse; current bulk-download availability not tested.
sources.security_use: Historical outage exposure and resilience research.
sources.limitations: Does not provide current outages. Collection gaps and varying utility coverage affect comparisons.

sources.name: Austin Energy outage map
sources.update_frequency: Operational outage updates; inspect map timestamps.
sources.license_notes: Public utility status map; integration and redistribution terms require provider review.
sources.security_use: Local utility outage awareness and restoration context.
sources.limitations: Service territory differs from city boundaries; map estimates do not establish building-level service.

sources.name: DC Water service alerts and outage map
sources.coverage: DC Water service area, Washington, DC
sources.update_frequency: Incident-driven notices and utility updates.
sources.license_notes: Public utility information; no supported public machine API validated here.
sources.security_use: Water service interruptions, repairs and local operational awareness.
sources.limitations: Confirm the applicable service area and advisory details. Absence from a map does not establish service.

sources.name: USGS modern Water Data APIs
sources.update_frequency: Sensor and telemetry dependent; historical series also available.
sources.license_notes: Public USGS data; consult current API-key, quota and service guidance for the selected endpoint.
sources.security_use: Streamflow, gauge height and water-resource conditions affecting sites and routes.
sources.limitations: Not a drinking-water outage feed. Prefer modern APIs; legacy WaterServices retirement is announced for early 2027.

sources.name: EPA drinking-water systems and compliance data
sources.update_frequency: Periodic reporting; ECHO download documentation describes quarterly refreshes.
sources.license_notes: Public EPA releases; consult data dictionaries and completeness caveats.
sources.security_use: Identify water systems and review reported compliance history.
sources.limitations: Historical compliance records do not establish current water safety or report active outages.

sources.name: IODA internet outage detection
sources.coverage: Global country, region and autonomous-system observations
sources.update_frequency: Signal-dependent observation windows; check series timestamps.
sources.license_notes: Public research interface; verify current data-reuse terms before production redistribution.
sources.security_use: Regional communications disruption and business-continuity context.
sources.limitations: Inferred internet anomalies do not prove a cause or establish connectivity at a specific site.

sources.name: Cloudflare Radar outages and traffic anomalies
sources.coverage: Global; country, region and network coverage varies
sources.update_frequency: Outage annotations and anomaly updates; inspect reported times.
sources.license_notes: API token with Radar read permission; follow Cloudflare terms and attribution requirements.
sources.security_use: Corroborate regional internet disruptions affecting offices and services.
sources.limitations: Cloudflare observations are not a complete view of every network or individual connection.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.update_frequency: Continuously edited; extracts have their own snapshot dates.
sources.license_notes: ODbL database license; attribution and applicable share-alike terms. Tile-server policies are separate.
sources.security_use: Road, building and place context for situational-awareness maps.
sources.limitations: Map features are not a live incident or verified critical-infrastructure inventory.

sources.name: Overture Maps
sources.update_frequency: Versioned releases; pin the release used.
sources.license_notes: Licensing and attribution vary by theme and source; inspect current attribution documentation.
sources.security_use: Buildings, transport and place context for facility exposure analysis.
sources.limitations: Feature presence, geometry and business attributes can be incomplete or outdated.

sources.name: Humanitarian Data Exchange
sources.provider: UN OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data / contributing organizations
sources.update_frequency: Dataset-specific; inspect source and last update.
sources.license_notes: Dataset-specific licenses and access conditions; tabular endpoints require an HDX API token.
sources.security_use: Find administrative boundaries, infrastructure and humanitarian baseline data.
sources.limitations: Some datasets require access approval; country and dataset coverage varies. Portal fetch returned 403 in this review.
